nodes.label: Node Engine Architecture (V1 to V6)
nodes.rationale: Captures evolution from a simple node-based structure to a full autonomous AI education ecosystem across six versions.

nodes.label: V1 - Core Node Engine
nodes.rationale: Foundational layer where every entity (exam, year, tier, subject, chapter, topic, test, quiz, AI path) is a single unified node in one table.

nodes.label: V2 - Intelligence Layer
nodes.rationale: Adds performance signals and adaptive difficulty on top of V1 static nodes: AI meta, user skill tracking, recommendation, spaced repetition, adaptive tests.

nodes.label: V3 - AI Tutor Engine
nodes.rationale: Shifts from recommendation to conversational Socratic teaching with mistake-driven learning and persistent tutor memory.

nodes.label: V4 - Autonomous Education System
nodes.rationale: Proactive full-syllabus generation, AI-authored questions, dynamic exam creation, and self-improving feedback loop.

nodes.label: V5 - AGI Education System
nodes.rationale: Whole-exam generation, simulated exam authorities, world model of education state, and self-reflective improvement.

nodes.label: V6 - Education Civilization
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent ecosystem with competing AI teachers, student/teacher agents, knowledge economy with tokens, and a meta governor.

nodes.label: nodes (unified hierarchy table)
nodes.rationale: Single Postgres table holding all entity types via a `type` column (exam/session/stage/category/test/topic/ai_path/revision_plan) with parent_id self-reference and JSONB meta/ai_meta/tutor_strategy.

nodes.label: user_node_skill
nodes.rationale: Per-user per-node mastery and confidence scores, attempt counts, weak/strong points JSONB, used by V2 recommendation and spaced repetition.

nodes.label: ai_tutor_memory
nodes.rationale: Persists conversation history, knowledge gaps, emotional/confidence state, and mistake patterns for the V3 AI tutor.

nodes.label: curriculum_nodes
nodes.rationale: V4 stores per-topic weightage, importance, predicted question count and confidence per exam.

nodes.label: ai_generated_questions
nodes.rationale: Stores LLM-authored questions with difficulty, prediction score, quality score, concept_tested, common_mistakes and verified flag.

nodes.label: exam_simulations
nodes.rationale: Persists predicted score, rank, percentile, weak/strong topic JSONB and a generated study_plan per simulation run.

nodes.label: education_world_state
nodes.rationale: V5 global model: skill graph, difficulty landscape, exam evolution, student distribution and a generation counter.

nodes.label: agi_generated_exams
nodes.rationale: V5 stores whole exams produced by the AGI: pattern, questions, difficulty curve, predicted success rate and rank distribution.

nodes.label: micro_skills
nodes.rationale: Tracks micro-skills with emergence_score, trend (emerging/stable/declining) and prerequisite list for V5/V6 evolution.

nodes.label: student_agents
nodes.rationale: V6 student agent: skill_vector, short/long term memory, strategy (aggressive/steady/balanced), total_xp, level, learning_style.

nodes.label: teacher_agents
nodes.rationale: V6 teacher agent: teaching style (socratic/direct/discovery), effectiveness, specializations, adaptability and improvement history.

nodes.label: skill_economy
nodes.rationale: V6 market dynamics per skill: demand, supply, value, trend (rising/stable/falling) and price_history.

nodes.label: student_wealth
nodes.rationale: Holds knowledge_tokens, skill_portfolio, trade_history and achievements for each student.

nodes.label: exam_events
nodes.rationale: Global competition events: mock_exam/competition/challenge with timing, rewards, leaderboard and status.

nodes.label: createNode
nodes.rationale: V1 service that validates the type against an allowlist and inserts a row into the `nodes` table.

nodes.label: resolvePath
nodes.rationale: V1 service that walks an array of slugs to find a node by parent-chain, used by the catch-all route handler.

nodes.label: getNodeWithCache
nodes.rationale: Redis-backed cache wrapper around resolvePath, key `node:slug1/slug2/...`, TTL 1 hour.

nodes.label: calculateMastery
nodes.rationale: V2 mastery = accuracy * timeFactor, capped at 1; the cornerstone of user_node_skill updates.

nodes.label: updateMastery
nodes.rationale: UPSERT into user_node_skill after every attempt, recomputing mastery from cumulative correct/total.

nodes.label: updateNodeDifficulty
nodes.rationale: V2 derives aggregate difficulty as 1 - correct_rate over attempts and writes it into nodes.ai_meta.

nodes.label: getRecommendationScore
nodes.rationale: Weighted sum: (1-mastery)*0.4 + difficulty*0.2 + examWeight*0.2 + freshness*0.2.

nodes.label: generateLearningPath
nodes.rationale: V2 partitions descendant nodes into weak/moderate/strong by score and returns priority/secondary/reinforcement lists.

nodes.label: shouldRevise / getRevisionSchedule
nodes.rationale: Spaced-repetition decision: daysSince > 1/(mastery+0.1), urgency = same denominator.

nodes.label: generateAdaptiveTest
nodes.rationale: V2 builds an adaptive test by distributing questions inversely proportional to mastery across weak nodes.

nodes.label: askTutor
nodes.rationale: V3 orchestrator: gathers node + memory + userSkill, builds a prompt, calls an LLM, parses and saves the exchange.

nodes.label: buildTutorPrompt
nodes.rationale: Composes a Socratic, JSON-formatted prompt that injects the last 5 exchanges, knowledge gaps and teaching strategy.

nodes.label: determineNextLayer (DIAGNOSE..ASSESS)
nodes.rationale: V3 state machine over five tutoring layers: diagnose -> explain -> guide -> practice -> assess -> next_topic.

nodes.label: analyzeMistake
nodes.rationale: V3 classifies errors as conceptual/calculation/careless/misunderstood and returns severity + suggestion.

nodes.label: getTeachingBehavior
nodes.rationale: V3 maps student level (beginner/intermediate/advanced) to explanation depth, hint frequency, example count and encouragement.

nodes.label: generateCurriculum / analyzeFrequency
nodes.rationale: V4 mines past papers to produce weighted curriculum_nodes entries (frequency, relevance, predicted count).

nodes.label: predictQuestions
nodes.rationale: V4 blends historical frequency (40%), recent trend (30%) and importance (30%) to rank topic-level predictions.

nodes.label: generateAIQuestion
nodes.rationale: V4 LLM prompt that emits a JSON question and persists it to ai_generated_questions with concepts and common mistakes.

nodes.label: simulateExam / calculateExpectedScore
nodes.rationale: V4 score formula: sum of topic-level mastery*question_count minus negative marking on assumed 25% wrong.

nodes.label: updateSystemFromResults (self-improving loop)
nodes.rationale: V4 fans out to updateNodeDifficulty, updateQuestionQuality, adjustCurriculumWeights, updateUserSkill after each run.

nodes.label: AGIDecide
nodes.rationale: V5 central brain: returns boolean/intent decisions (update curriculum, retrain tutor, spawn skills) from world-state insights.

nodes.label: simulatePopulation / estimateRank
nodes.rationale: V5 generates 10k synthetic students, scores them, and converts a user score into a percentile-based rank.

nodes.label: selfReflect
nodes.rationale: V5 detects low_mastery/high_dropout/question_quality inefficiencies and applies generated improvements.

nodes.label: civilizationCycle
nodes.rationale: V6 main loop: interactions, learning, exams, performance analysis, economy update, agent evolution, sleep.

nodes.label: tradeSkill
nodes.rationale: V6 knowledge-economy transaction: deducts tokens from buyer, pays 10% creator fee, grants access, updates skill economy.

nodes.label: MetaGovernor
nodes.rationale: V6 system-level controller: evolves curriculum, scales difficulty by global mastery, spawns teachers on demand, balances economy.

nodes.label: Everything is a Node
nodes.rationale: Design principle: a single `nodes` table with `type` discriminates every entity, enabling unlimited hierarchy depth, no schema migrations, and AI-ready meta.

nodes.label: Hybrid IDs (BIGSERIAL + UUID public_id)
nodes.rationale: Integer id for joins, UUID for external APIs to avoid enumeration and support batched migration.

nodes.label: JSONB Flexibility (meta / ai_meta / tutor_strategy)
nodes.rationale: Per-version JSONB columns let new features (intelligence, tutoring) extend nodes without altering the schema.

nodes.label: Catch-all route + slug path resolver
nodes.rationale: Single Express route `/*` splits the URL, runs resolvePath, and returns the node + its children.

nodes.label: Redis caching of resolved paths
nodes.rationale: 1-hour TTL cache keyed by joined slug path drives the >90% cache-hit target and <50ms path resolution SLA.

nodes.label: Recursive CTE for tree and path traversal
nodes.rationale: Postgres WITH RECURSIVE unions for descendants and ancestors of a node, supporting unlimited depth without N+1 queries.

nodes.label: Socratic multi-layer tutor state machine
nodes.rationale: Diagnose -> Explain -> Guide -> Practice -> Assess transitions on success/failure, never giving the full answer up front.

nodes.label: Closed feedback loop (results -> model updates)
nodes.rationale: After every exam, mastery/difficulty/curriculum weights and question quality are recomputed - core to V4 self-improvement and V5 self-reflection.

nodes.label: Knowledge Economy (tokens, supply/demand)
nodes.rationale: V6 models skills as tradeable assets: knowledge_tokens, demand/supply/value, 10% creator fee on each trade.

nodes.label: Multi-agent student/teacher ecosystem
nodes.rationale: Competing AI teachers matched to students via findBestTeacher; student and teacher agents update each other after every session.

nodes.label: World Model + Meta Governor
nodes.rationale: V5/V6 keep a global education_world_state row and a MetaGovernor that scales difficulty, evolves micro_skills, and spawns agents on demand.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Primary OLTP store; uses BIGSERIAL, UUID, JSONB, gen_random_uuid, and WITH RECURSIVE.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.rationale: Caching path resolutions, also caches the simulated population for rank estimation.

nodes.label: LLM (OpenAI / Claude)
nodes.rationale: Powers V3 tutor responses, V4 question generation and V5 exam generation through a single callLLM helper.

nodes.label: Vector DB (Embeddings)
nodes.rationale: Listed in the data layer for embedding-based retrieval by tutor and recommendation services.

nodes.label: Production layered architecture
nodes.rationale: Client -> API Gateway -> Application (Node/Tutor/Exam services) -> AI/ML -> Data (Postgres/Redis/Vector) layers.

nodes.label: Node Types (extensible enum)
nodes.rationale: Allowed values for nodes.type: exam, session, stage, category, subcategory, subject, chapter, topic, test, quiz, question_set, ai_path, revision_plan, skill_node.
